intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.body: This Privacy Policy explains how Lyra (“we”, “our”, or “the application”) collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our application. By using Lyra, you agree to the practices described in this policy. If you do not agree with this Privacy Policy, please do not use the application.

controller.title: 2. Who We Are
controller.body:
Lyra is an independent personal finance application operated as an early-stage product. For the purposes of applicable data protection laws, Lyra acts as the data controller responsible for your personal data.

Country of operation: Israel

account.title: Account Information
account.body: When you sign in using Google authentication, we receive your name, email address, and profile image as provided by Google.

financial.title: Financial Data
financial.body: All financial data in Lyra is manually entered by you. We do not connect to banks, scrape financial institutions, use open banking APIs, or import data automatically. Your data is used only to display insights within the application.

technical.title: Technical Data
technical.body: We collect limited technical information such as browser type, operating system, and access times to ensure the security and proper functioning of the service. We record your IP address and browser user agent only at the moment you accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, and store them as proof of consent (see the consentIp and consentUserAgent fields on your user record). We do not log IP addresses for general application usage.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.body: We process personal data based on one or more of the following legal grounds: providing the service you request, your consent when using the application, and our legitimate interest in operating and securing the service. This policy aligns with the Israeli Privacy Protection Law (5741-1981, as amended) and with GDPR principles.

usage.title: 5. How We Use Your Information
items: Store and display your financial data as entered by you
Comply with legal obligations when required

deletion.title: 6. Data Deletion and Retention
deletion.body: You can delete your account at any time from within the application. Active account data is retained for as long as your account exists. After you delete your account, all associated personal and financial data is permanently removed within 30 days. Product usage analytics events automatically expire after 12 months via a database TTL index.

rights.title: 7. Your Privacy Rights
rights.body: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data. You can also download a machine-readable copy of your data from Settings → Privacy & Data. Requests can be made by contacting us using the email address below.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.essentialBody: Required for authentication, session management, and core app functionality. These cannot be disabled.
cookies.analyticsBody: Usage events that help us improve Lyra. Each event is stored with your display name and avatar so we can see how real users interact with the app — these events are not anonymous. Opt-in via the consent banner shown after sign-in. You can change your choice at any time from Settings → Privacy & Data.
cookies.vercelBody: Aggregate page-view metrics collected via Vercel Analytics. Only loaded when you have opted in to product usage analytics.
cookies.loginBody: Sign-in events are recorded for security and audit purposes under our legitimate interest. These are kept independent of analytics consent.

thirdParties.title: 9. Third-Party Services
thirdParties.body: Lyra stores your data on MongoDB Atlas in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany region). We use Google OAuth for authentication only — Google does not receive your financial data. The frontend is hosted on Vercel and the backend is hosted on Render. These providers process data only as required to operate the service.

age.title: 10. Age Requirement
age.body: Lyra is intended for users aged 16 and older. We do not knowingly collect personal data from individuals under the age of 16.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
